title: Letter on Sullivan's death sent to the FBI but never received

tellings.quote: And we I took we took that information. We've composed a letter, sent it to the FBI uh through the oversight committee only to later we we we had been told that it had been sent later we found out that it had never been received.

plain: Congressman Eric Burlison says a letter about the death of a man named Sullivan was sent to the FBI through the House Oversight Committee but never arrived. He tells Michels that he and others took information connected to the whistleblower David Grusch, wrote the letter, and were told it had been sent, "only to later" learn "it had never been received." If true, a congressional inquiry into a death went missing somewhere along the way.
